dct_description_sm: Colombia administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 02. This dataset is structured into 3 levels: - Admin 1: 33 Departement - Admin 2: 1122 Municipality (municipio or distrito) - Admin 3: 31880 corregimiento or comuna, partial coverage Dates associated with this dataset: - 20 November 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 16 April 2020: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 01 December 2019: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 01 December 2019: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Latin America and the Caribbean (ROLAC)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-rolac). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
